description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the rollout of a software platform into customer-managed environments, from cloud private networks to on-premises hardware. Work directly with customer technical and security teams to plan, troubleshoot and automate deployments, and turn one-off efforts into repeatable patterns.
 What you'll do
 - Lead deployments end to end in customer environments, covering planning, configuration, testing and rollout across private cloud and on-premises setups.
 - Work directly with customer engineers and senior stakeholders, including through shared channels, calls and occasional site visits.
 - Diagnose and resolve customer-specific infrastructure problems such as container orchestration misconfigurations, cloud identity and access edge cases, and networking faults.
 - Build monitoring, telemetry and automation that make deployments repeatable and scalable.
 - Learn the hardware behind machine learning workloads so they can be deployed on infrastructure the customer controls.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 3 to 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience.
 - Past ownership of core container orchestration and cloud infrastructure at a high-bar technology company or startup.
 - Deep production expertise with Kubernetes and Terraform.
 - Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, networking and infrastructure as code.
 - Clear communication and the ability to diagnose problems live with external engineering teams.
 - A standout track record, such as fast promotions, notable open-source work or founding-engineer scope.
 Bonus points
 - Experience delivering software into environments that customers control, such as private cloud, air-gapped or on-premises installs.
 - A background in a small, rapidly scaling company.
 - A technical degree from a strong program.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Parental leave
 - Flexible time off
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
